limitations: Historical synthetic/model calibration only; no new scientific adjudication or nature-level inference.

legacy.claim: On a synthetic, purely Newtonian wide-binary population with a realistic nonuniform sky footprint (declination-dependent quality/completeness gradient, anisotropic density) and zero injected acceleration-dependent kinematics, Astrolabe's baseline selection pipeline (quality cuts, theta/s window, escape-speed PM gate) recovers a v-tilde(g_N) profile whose deviation from its own Newtonian-mock comparator stays below the predeclared threshold (abs(B_i) < 0.04 in median v-tilde) in every populated g_N bin.
legacy.kill: Any populated bin (n >= 5 pairs) shows abs(B_i) >= 0.04 in median v-tilde, reproducibly across the seed ladder (median seed-to-seed abs(B_i) at or above threshold), under the baseline nonuniform-footprint arm (R1) at the operational max_stars=8000 cap.
